apiProxy.note: HTTP API of the a05-arch-dev stack (aivar-tech/architecture-design-agent) in account 455162169375, us-east-1. GET /session and GET /runs answer at the root (default stage), so originPath is empty: /agents/architecture-design/api/runs becomes /runs. Every route needs the shared X-Access-Key header: the Architecture Design key gate (infra/key_gates.py) adds it from Secrets Manager a05-arch-dev/access-key for signed-in people and calls the API's dev stage (/dev/<path>); the screens never hold the key. Forward all methods, the query string and every header except Host. Do not cache.

note: The dashboard serves the screens (src/features/architecture-design). Only the API is proxied. Diagrams come back inside the JSON as data, so no extra image host is needed. The sample run's files are static: public/agents/architecture-design/.
